name: Tsubata-kun
source: The main character who is a third-year university student, virgin and [url=/c33597]Nao's[/url] neighbor. He treats Nao like his little sister and isn't really interested in girls because he's gay. Tsubata's dream is to become a teacher. He is also secretly a sadist.
